verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly the same. Both put the cross on its own at the right edge of the text column instead of centred above 'Worship & Bible Study', and both chop the mountain illustration off with a hard vertical edge on its left, so it looks pasted into the right half and leaves a dead empty area at bottom-left. A also has uneven vertical spacing: the dates sit close under the invite line, then a large gap opens before 'Worship & Bible Study'. B spaces the invite, dates and worship lines more evenly, which makes its text block a little more deliberate.
